'''Joe Malcolm Harris''' (born September 7, 1991) is an American [[basketball]] player who recently completed his college career at the [[University of Virginia]].

Harris, a 6'6" [[shooting guard]] from [[Chelan, Washington]], came to Virginia in 2010 and entered the starting lineup almost immediately.  As a freshman, he scored 10.4 [[points per game]].  In his sophomore season of [[2011–12 Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball team|2011–12]], Harris upped his scoring to 11.3 per game - second on the team to [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] [[Mike Scott (basketball)|Mike Scott]] - and helped lead the Cavaliers to the [[2012 NCAA Men's Division I Basketball Tournament|2012 NCAA Tournament]], the program's first tournament bid under coach [[Tony Bennett (basketball)|Tony Bennett]] and first since 2007.<ref>{{cite web | last = Doughty | first = Doug | title = Virginia gets date with Florida; NCAA absence ends | work = [[The Roanoke Times]] | date = October 17, 2013| url = http://hamptonroads.com/2012/03/virginia-gets-10-seed-ncaa-mens-tournament | accessdate = November 14, 2013}}</ref>

In his junior year, Harris became one of the top players in the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC).  He led the Cavaliers to a 23-12 record, scoring 16.3 points and collecting 4.0 [[rebounds per game]].  He was named first team All-ACC at the conclusion of the season.<ref>{{cite web | last = Giannotto | first = Mark | title = Virginia Tech’s Erick Green, Virginia’s Joe Harris are part of all-ACC basketball team | work = [[Washington Post]] | date = March 11, 2013| url = http://articles.washingtonpost.com/2013-03-11/sports/37615682_1_acc-player-acc-tournament-team-all-acc | accessdate = November 14, 2013}}</ref>

Going into his senior season in [[2013–14 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2013–14]], Harris received significant preseason recognition.  He was a member of the preseason All-ACC team<ref>{{cite web | last = Robinson | first = Tom | title = U.Va.'s Harris named to preseason All-ACC first team | work = [[The Virginian-Pilot]] | date = October 17, 2013| url = http://hamptonroads.com/2013/10/uvas-harris-named-preseason-allacc-first-team | accessdate = November 14, 2013}}</ref> and was named to the preseason watch list for the [[Wooden Award]] as national player of the year.<ref>{{cite web | last = Fagan | first = Ryan | title = Wooden Award 2013-14: Preseason watch list released | work = [[Sporting News]] | date = November 12, 2013| url = http://www.sportingnews.com/ncaa-basketball/story/2013-11-12/wooden-award-2013-14-preseason-watch-list-finalists | accessdate = November 14, 2013}}</ref>
